question: 1. Does intercropping performance vary with climatic stress?
evidence_required: Many independent site-years with year-specific LER spanning a wide range of stress, with enough site-years per stress level
can_assess_now: Number of independent site-years (259) and how many are year-specific; geographic and temporal spread
needs_climate_data: Stress values per site-year; whether the stress gradient is wide and evenly sampled
explanation: 108 papers and 259 site-years across 22 countries give a reasonable base, but observations are clustered (top 10 papers = 39.8% of observations) and some site-years pool several years, so the effective sample is the site-year count, not 1496 rows

question: 2. Do functional intercropping systems respond differently to climatic stress?
evidence_required: As (1), within EACH system group, and system groups observed under overlapping stress ranges and regions
can_assess_now: Papers and site-years per system group; 6 groups have 5+ papers; system-geography confounding
needs_climate_data: Whether system groups overlap in stress space, or system and climate are confounded
explanation: Evidence is dominated by cereal + legume (73 papers); most other groups have few papers and are geographically concentrated (see system x geography heatmap), so system and location effects may be hard to separate

question: 3. Are there climatic/environmental limits beyond which intercropping advantage declines?
evidence_required: Dense evidence at the extremes of the stress gradient; enough independent site-years to estimate a threshold or slope change
can_assess_now: Only the volume and spread of independent evidence; not whether extremes are represented
needs_climate_data: Coverage of the stress extremes; whether extreme site-years come from few papers
explanation: Thresholds need many independent site-years at the stress extremes; with evidence clustered in few papers and regions this is unlikely to be well identified, but it cannot be judged until stress is attached

question: 4. Does intercropping reduce or avoid productivity losses under stressful conditions?
evidence_required: Paired observations of the same system under stressed and non-stressed conditions (multi-year, multi-season or water contrasts), ideally with sole-crop yields
can_assess_now: 59 papers with a potential within-study repeated-condition comparison (55 multi-year, 6 water/irrigation contrast)
needs_climate_data: Whether repeated years/seasons actually differ in stress; which condition is the stressed one
explanation: Feasible only for the 59 papers with within-study repeated conditions; whether these contrasts involve real stress differences is unknown until climate is linked

question: 5. Can empirical intercropping relationships be transferred spatially across SSA?
evidence_required: Broad, even geographic coverage; environmental conditions at prediction locations represented in the training data; out-of-region validation
can_assess_now: Geographic coverage of papers and locations (maps, grid density, regional gaps)
needs_climate_data: Environmental similarity of target areas to sampled sites (extrapolation risk)
explanation: Coverage is concentrated in a few countries and regions, with large gaps; spatial transfer would require extrapolation, which a structural count cannot justify
